text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory is finally starting her
senior
year. And how is she starting off
this new
chapter?

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
And now, let's look back on some of the
greatest
moments in the Twinkle Series
last year!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's starting! It's starting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's requested that we watch a TV
program
looking back on last year's
races in my office
today.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
It's impossible to talk about last year
without
mentioning the Beast herself,
Oguri Cap! She
gave us so many
memorable races!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! It's Oguri! Of course!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Her race against White Lightning,
Tamamo Cross,
left quite an impression
on viewers. I've become
quite a fan
myself!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! They're both so cool!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be a stretch to say she's
dominated
the Twinkle Series spotlight.
This might just be
the dawn of the Oguri
Cap era.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oguri's own era?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The program ends up spending the
whole runtime
on Oguri Cap, essentially
becoming a special
feature on her.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hrm... It's one thing to leave out my
sprints, but I
can believe they didn't
show Yaeno or anyone
else either! What
a bummer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But... I guess that just shows how
impressive Oguri
was last year.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. That must be it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Someday... I want to race against Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear Bamboo Memory has Oguri Cap
on her
mind as well. Likely because of a
certain
interaction from her past.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And... that was an amazing race. I hope
to run
with you again.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of... OF COURSE! I promise—you
haven't seen
the last of me, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I... Sniff... Sob!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's just—it's so, SO frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before Bamboo Memory made her
debut, she
competed against Oguri Cap
in a Tracen Meet.
Despite being a bitter
defeat, it was followed by
a promise for
the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since that day, Oguri Cap has had
a
special place in her thoughts—as a
racer she'd like
to compete against again
one day.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Is there any chance that I
could race
Oguri again?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Oguri Cap's racing history,
she
primarily focuses on mile and
medium-distance
races. There's a pretty
good chance she'll be in a
G1 mile.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A mile? That's one of the two kinds of
races I'm
aiming to dominate...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...All right! I've got it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'm going to race against
Oguri in a G1
mile and win! I have to, if
I'm going to be the best
at miles!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Only then will I be able to stand loud
and proud
and say... Bamboo Memory
rules the mile!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory's unwavering
determination in
the face of the public's
current obsession with
Oguri Cap is
quite reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet again, I can't help but think that this

indomitable spirit of hers is her greatest
strength.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But first, there's the Takamatsunomiya
Kinen
sprint! That's my first step to the
top!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And that will lead us to a G1 mile! I'll
make these
words into reality!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that Bamboo Memory has a nice,
positive
outlook for the future...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us visit a shrine to pray for
good luck
in her senior year.

text_block_list.name: Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how many races Oguri will win
this year...
Maybe she'll go the whole
year undefeated!

text_block_list.name: Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
Well, it certainly seems possible. She's in
another
league right now. Plus, she's
always trending on
social media
whenever she's racing.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Those people just now were talking
about Oguri!
She really is all the rage!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's like they didn't even see me. She
really is all
anyone can talk about...
choice_data_list: それだけブームを起こしているんだろうね
choice_data_list_en: It must really be kicking off quite a craze.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, that doesn't matter! I've just got to
focus on
my own path! I'm gonna pray
even harder than
last year!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, what are you going
to pray for
this year, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're totally right! Can't race or
train if
you're not in tip-top shape!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Okay then! I'll follow your example and
pray for
good health too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we both pray for good health as
we
prepare to face the challenges
awaiting us in her
senior year!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Now that's what I call ambition!
Yeah, I
definitely wanna grow as a
racer—mentally,
physically, technically...
EVERYTHING!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm gonna pray for growth too, so
we can
aim higher and higher!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we both pray for growth as we
prepare to
face the challenges awaiting
us in her senior year!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Luck?! That's not quite what I expected!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But sure enough, luck is essential in the

competitive world... Now that I think
about it, I
think that's a great choice!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right, that's settled! I'm going to pray
for luck
as well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we both pray for good luck as
we prepare
to face the challenges
awaiting us in her senior
year!
